newsletter.title: Frontier Physics Solvers & Grok CLI Security Vulnerabilities
newsletter.introduction: Welcome to TheFutureLoop (TFL). Today we cover Claude Fable solving a 6-month-old theoretical physics problem, a critical Grok CLI data exposure bug, and Richard Sutton's new Oak Lab.

stories.title: Claude Fable solves 6-month physics problem for theorist Yuji Tachikawa
stories.body: Leading mathematical physicist Yuji Tachikawa reports Claude Fable solved a physics problem that his research team was stuck on for six months. This marks a shift from simple coding assistance to frontier scientific reasoning partnership.

stories.title: Grok CLI security bug uploads entire user home directory to GCS
stories.body: A severe security vulnerability inside the Grok CLI tool causes it to upload the user's entire local home directory to public xAI and GCS buckets during standard CLI execution blocks.

stories.title: Richard Sutton launches Oak Lab for real-time planning on 20 watts
stories.body: Reinforcement Learning pioneer Richard Sutton announces Oak Lab, aiming to build a trillion-parameter real-time learning agent operating within a biological 20-watt power constraint.

stories.title: Show HN: Clawk - Disposable Linux VMs for Coding Agents
stories.body: An open-source sandboxing library that deploys coding agents inside temporary, disposable micro-VM environments to protect host developer machines from data exposure and command injection.

stories.title: Cloudflare launches Precursor edge compute sandbox
stories.body: Cloudflare's new Precursor virtualization layer improves edge execution sandbox boot times by 40%, optimizing serverless dispatch under high concurrency.

newsletter.takeaway: When deploying coding agents, compile execution blocks in disposable containers like Clawk. Always verify CLI tool telemetry variables before running commands inside root directories.
